In 2019, Tafur KT, Coit J, Leon SR, Pinedo C, Chiang SS, Contreras C, and colleagues investigated the feasibility of using the string test for diagnosing tuberculosis in children aged 4 to 14 years. This study was published in BMC Infectious Diseases in 2018. 2. Walters E, Demers AM, van der Zalm MM, Whitelaw A, Palmer M, Bosch C, and colleagues explored the use of stool culture as a diagnostic tool for pulmonary tuberculosis in children. Their findings were published in the Journal of Clinical Microbiology in 2017. 3. Walters E, Scott L, Nabeta P, Demers AM, Reubenson G, Bosch C, and colleagues developed a novel centrifugation-free method for molecular detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in stool samples from young children. This study was published in the Journal of Clinical Microbiology in 2018. 4. Walters E, van der Zalm MM, Palmer M, Bosch C, Demers AM, Draper H, and colleagues demonstrated the utility of the Xpert MTB/RIF assay on stool samples for rapid tuberculosis diagnosis in young children with severe pulmonary disease. This research was published in the Pediatric Infectious Disease Journal in 2017. 5. Nicol MP, Workman L, Prins M, Bateman L, Ghebrekristos Y, Mbhele S, and colleagues assessed the accuracy of the Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra assay for diagnosing pulmonary tuberculosis in children. Their findings were published in the Pediatric Infectious Disease Journal in 2018. 6. Orikiriza P, Nansumba M, Nyehangane D, Bastard M, Mugisha IT, Nansera D, and colleagues evaluated the use of Xpert MTB/RIF for diagnosing childhood tuberculosis from sputum and stool samples in a high TB-HIV-prevalent setting. This study was published in the European Journal of Clinical Microbiology & Infectious Diseases in 2018. 7. Giang do C, Duong TN, Ha DT, Nhan HT, Wolbers M, Nhu NT, and colleagues conducted a prospective evaluation of the GeneXpert assay for diagnosing HIV-negative pediatric tuberculosis cases. This study was published in BMC Infectious Diseases in 2015. 8. Zawedde-Muyanja S, Nakanwagi A, Dongo JP, Sekadde MP, Nyinoburyo R, Ssentongo G, and colleagues reported that decentralizing child tuberculosis services in Uganda increased case detection and uptake of preventive therapy. This study was published in the International Journal of Tuberculosis and Lung Disease in 2018. 9. Gunasekera KS, Walters E, van der Zalm MM, Palmer M, Warren JL, Hesseling AC, and colleagues developed a treatment-decision algorithm for HIV-uninfected children being evaluated for pulmonary tuberculosis. This study was published in Clinical Infectious Diseases in 2021. 10. Edwards K reviewed the diagnosis of childhood tuberculosis in a study published in the PNG Medical Journal in 1987. 11. Marcy O, Borand L, Ung V, Msellati P, Tejiokem M, Huu KT, and colleagues proposed a treatment-decision score for HIV-infected children with suspected tuberculosis. This study was published in Pediatrics in 2019. 12. Montenegro SH, Gilman RH, Sheen P, Cama R, Caviedes L, Hopper T, and colleagues improved the detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis in Peruvian children using a heminested IS6110 polymerase chain reaction assay. This study was published in Clinical Infectious Diseases in 2003. 13. Marais BJ, Gie RP, Hesseling AC, Schaaf HS, Lombard C, Enarson DA, and colleagues refined a symptom-based approach to diagnose pulmonary tuberculosis in children. This study was published in Pediatrics in 2006. 14. Schaaf HS, Marais BJ, Whitelaw A, Hesseling AC, Eley B, Hussey GD, and colleagues reviewed 596 cases of culture-confirmed childhood tuberculosis in Cape Town, South Africa. This study was published in BMC Infectious Diseases in 2007. 15. van Toorn R, Schaaf HS, Laubscher JA, van Elsland SL, Donald PR, Schoeman JF, and colleagues evaluated short intensified treatment regimens in children with drug-susceptible tuberculous meningitis. This study was published in the Pediatric Infectious Disease Journal in 2014. 16. van Well GT, Paes BF, Terwee CB, Springer P, Roord JJ, Donald PR, and colleagues conducted a retrospective cohort study on pediatric tuberculous meningitis over 20 years in the Western Cape of South Africa. This study was published in Pediatrics in 2009. 17. Bang ND, Caws M, Truc TT, Duong TN, Dung NH, Ha DTM, and colleagues described clinical presentations, diagnostic challenges, mortality, and prognostic markers of tuberculous meningitis in Vietnamese children. This study was published in BMC Infectious Diseases in 2016. 18. Solomons R investigated developmental outcomes at treatment completion in South African children with tuberculous meningitis in 2015. 19. Dhawan SR, Gupta A, Singhi P, Sankhyan N, Malhi P, Khandelwal N, and colleagues identified predictors of neurological outcomes in childhood tuberculous meningitis in a prospective cohort study from a developing country. This study was published in the Journal of Child Neurology in 2016. 20. Gupta R, Kushwaha S, Thakur R, Jalan N, Rawat P, Gupta P, and colleagues identified predictors of adverse outcomes in patients with tuberculous meningitis in a multicentric study from India. This study was published in the Indian Journal of Tuberculosis in 2017.
